🎬 Scary Movie 3 (2003)

Scary Movie 3 follows Cindy Campbell, a television news reporter who investigates a mysterious videotape that supposedly kills anyone who watches it within seven days. Her investigation leads her to a struggling farmer named Tom Logan and his brother George, who discover strange crop circles on their property. As Cindy attempts to uncover the connection between the cursed videotape and a potential alien invasion, she encounters bizarre characters, ridiculous situations, and hilarious misunderstandings. Starring Anna Faris, Charlie Sheen, Regina Hall, and Leslie Nielsen, the film parodies popular movies such as The Ring, Signs, 8 Mile, and The Matrix. Combining outrageous humor, supernatural mysteries, and absurd storytelling, the movie delivers an entertaining blend of horror and comedy while poking fun at Hollywood’s most recognizable cinematic clichés.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Horror • Parody

⭐ IMDb: 5.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 24m • PG-13

🎥 Director: David Zucker

✍️ Writers: Craig Mazin & Pat Proft

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Scary Movie 3 is a 2003 American parody film directed by David Zucker and written by Craig Mazin and Pat Proft. It is the sequel to Scary Movie 2 (2001) and the third installment in the Scary Movie film series. The film stars Anna Faris and Regina Hall reprising their roles as Cindy Campbell and Brenda Meeks, alongside new cast members Charlie Sheen, Simon Rex, Anthony Anderson, Kevin Hart, Queen Latifah, and Leslie Nielsen. It is the first film in the series without the involvement of the Wayans family.
